backend.label: Backend command
backend.description: Path of the internal-keyboard CLI installed by setup.sh. Only change it if you installed the backend somewhere else.

show_osd.label: Show OSD popup
show_osd.description: Show the Noctalia popup with the new state whenever the keyboard is switched.

poll_interval.label: Refresh interval (ms)
poll_interval.description: How often the tile and the widget re-read the keyboard state.

device.label: Keyboard
device.description: Exact device name to switch; leave empty for the keyboard setup.sh picked. Run `internal-keyboard devices` in a terminal to list the names.

setup.title: Internal Keyboard needs setup
setup.hint: Run this once in a terminal, then reload the plugin: sudo %s/setup.sh
